purpose: Versioned extension of the single Stödassistenten demand/friction regression map. This mapping stores product-learning memory only; it does not prove eligibility or factual truth.

mappings.product_miss: A person describing a severely ill parent, partner, friend or neighbour can enter the broad relative route without discovering the existing near-relative benefit candidate, while overly broad keyword routing could wrongly imply that ordinary ageing, diagnosis or family relationship proves eligibility.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Detect only bounded near-relative-benefit or severe-illness-plus-close-person language, pass a coarse relative_care focus without raw story text, ask whether healthcare describes the condition as life-threatening and whether work or specified replacement benefit must be foregone, and preserve the existing NEEDS_REVIEW truth boundary.
